The high-intent photography-kit guide defines a complete purchase workflow, compatibility checks, rejection gates, no-purchase option, delivered-cost record, and return-window test without merchant links, commission pressure, live prices, ratings, stock, warranties, or invented testing.

image_qa.note: All three pages intentionally use text, tables, checklists, and existing interface assets. BaOx uses an IMAGE WITHHELD panel because a repository image cannot establish universal cultivar appearance and no licensed exact editorial image was selected. No product, cultivar, package, gear, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The October 12–November 8 BigBudMan report is five days old and valid: 815 impressions, three clicks, about 0.4% CTR, and average position 24.1. The two-impression “510 vs disposable” query at position 12 already maps to a complete comparison; Arkansas's six-impression, one-click page at position 9.7 was reinforced on November 12; Delaware had only two impressions, and Blue Dream averaged about position 47.6. No page is labeled Data-led. Those tiny, already-served, or weak-position signals were deliberately ignored. The reported sitemap errors favored stronger hub, reciprocal, complete-index, and canonical sitemap discovery paths instead of another isolated page or invented submission claim.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy ten-layer cannabis identity translator grounded in USDA's versioned hemp descriptor system, EMA terminology work, and peer-reviewed chemical-name research; added reciprocal contextual links from the glossary, indica/sativa, chemotype, CBD-hemp, seed, complaint, label, QR, and gear clusters. The BaOx profile preserves a documented spelling correction and conflicting crop-use context rather than manufacturing certainty. Two qualified public-sector or university resource opportunities were logged; no outreach was sent.
